ledger.summary: In mid-morning Ralph leaves, resolving to go on with the quest for the Well since nothing else seems possible. He follows the stream toward the Swelling Flood until the woods end in sheep downs, then takes a road across the downs. He meets armed Companions, two country women with an ass, merchants with servants, and a messenger. From a high hill he sees the Swelling Flood in its wide valley, with a broad shallow ford of a highway, a thorp on the far side, carts, sheds and cattle: a peopled land.
ledger.geography_notes: From the cave the stream leads toward the Swelling Flood; woods end; lower, longer hills of short grass (sheep downs, some shepherds). The stream bends north; a road crosses the downs; a long, high hill; below it the Swelling Flood in the wide valley, with the ford of a highway (wide and shallow), a little thorp on the far side, and settlement on both banks.
open_questions: Is this ford the same as the ford a mile and a half downstream in BONE-C17?
